english.note: Use 矛盾 when the tension is an actual conflict between people, sides, or opposing forces.

exampleSentences.english: The two of them argue all the time, and there is a lot of tension between them.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋兩個成日鬧交，大家之間有好大矛盾。
